name: stream finished completion
source: import { Readable, finished } from 'node:stream'; async function main(): Promise<void> { const input = Readable.from(['done']); const pending = new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => { finished(input, (error: unknown): void => { if (error) reject(error); else resolve(); }); }); input.resume(); await pending; console.log('finished'); }
